steps.title: Prepare media and thaw cells
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm R10 medium in a 37 °C water bath. Thaw cell vials in a 37 °C water bath, add the thawed cells to 14 mL of R10, spin at 500 ×g for 5 min, resuspend the pellet in 3 mL R10 and count the cells.

steps.title: Rest cells with DNAse I
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells at 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL in R10 medium containing 1 µL/mL DNAse I, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for at least 3 h (up to overnight). During this resting period, prepare the extracellular staining (ECS) antibody cocktail master mix and adjust the ECS volume to 50 µL per test with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Dilute and plate cells
steps.instruction: After resting, add PBS to bring the total volume to the nearest 15 mL or 50 mL (rounding up) and transfer to a 15 mL or 50 mL conical tube. Spin at 500 ×g for 5 min at room temperature, resuspend in PBS to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL and recount. If the suspension is too dilute, repeat the spin and resuspend again to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL. Transfer 200 mL of the cell suspension (containing 2 × 10⁶ cells) into each well of a V‑bottom 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Viability and extracellular staining
steps.instruction: Spin the 96‑well plate at 500 ×g for 5 min at room temperature, carefully remove the supernatant with a multichannel pipette, add 5 µL of 1:60 Aqua viability dye directly to each cell pellet, resuspend and incubate 10 min at room temperature in the dark. Add 50 µL of the ECS antibody cocktail, incubate 20 min at room temperature in the dark (prepare 1 % PFA fixation buffer while incubating). Add 100 µL FACS buffer to each well, spin again at 500 ×g for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 1× fixation/permeabilization buffer (1 part concentrate + 3 parts diluent) to each well, incubate 30 min at room temperature in the dark (make intracellular cytokine staining antibodies now). Add 100 µL of 1× perm/wash buffer and centrifuge at 800 ×g for 5 min. Remove supernatant, add 100 µL of intracellular cytokine staining (ICS) cocktail prepared in perm/wash buffer with diH₂O, and incubate 1 h at room temperature in the dark. Add 100 µL perm/wash buffer, centrifuge 800 ×g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 200 µL 1 % PFA, and transfer to FACS tubes.

steps.title: Store samples for acquisition
steps.instruction: Wrap the FACS tubes in aluminum foil and store at 4 °C until flow cytometry analysis.
